cases.message: the expression chain is too long (more than 4096 links): bind its parts to names and combine them in separate statements
cases.note: A chain is built in a loop, so the parser never recurses while reading one -- but the tree it builds is as tall as the chain, and every walk over it recurses. MaxExpressionChain (4096) bounds the links on any path from a node to a leaf; this file holds 4097 member reads. The file is deliberately large: the bound is three orders of magnitude above the longest chain in the shipped tree (8 links), so nothing smaller reaches it.

cases.message: the body nests too deeply (more than 256 levels): split the body into smaller logic calls
cases.note: The same bound as negative/concept, with the remedy a BODY earns. A statement block is a level and a logic's own body is not, so a body holds 256 blocks and is refused at the 257th.
